mapper.select: SELECT "a"."vehicle_id" , "a"."vehicle_name" FROM "vehicles" "a" INNER JOIN "operating_companies" "b" ON "b"."del_flag" = 0 AND "b"."available_flag" = 1 AND "b"."operating_company_id" = "a"."operating_company_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" "c" ON "c"."del_flag" = 0 AND "c"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."business_corp_id" = "b"."business_corp_id" WHERE "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "c"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId}

SELECT "a"."vehicle_id" , "a"."operating_company_id" , "b"."operating_name" , "a"."vehicle_name" , "a"."gps_serial" , "a"."available_flag" , "a"."japan_positioning_flag" FROM "vehicles" "a" INNER JOIN "operating_companies" "b" ON "b"."del_flag" = 0 AND "b"."available_flag" = 1 AND "b"."operating_company_id" = "a"."operating_company_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" "c" ON "c"."del_flag" = 0 AND "c"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."business_corp_id" = "b"."business_corp_id" WHERE "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."vehicle_id" = #{vehicleId} AND "c"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId}
